}}'''Kaila Bent''' is a member in the [[Queen's Guards]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Kaila Bent}}

== Appearance ==
She is lanky with fiery hair.

== Activities ==
She informs [[Birgitte Silverbow]] that they have caught [[Matrim Cauthon]] trying to sneak into the Palace. She witnesses [[Elayne Trakand]] [[Weave]] the [[Mask of Mirrors]] on herself when she goes to interrogate [[Chesmal Emry]].

== Trivia ==
* Kaila Bent is named for Kayla Bentley, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
